name: plan-and-execute
description: A planner writes the steps, an executor carries them out with helpers, and a reviewer sends the plan back for another try when it fell short (at most twice).

nodes.instruction: Write a numbered plan of at most four steps that answers the request in your input. If your input includes a reviewer's feedback, revise the plan to address it.
Carry out each step of the plan in your input, using your helpers: the researcher for facts, the drafter for prose. Answer with the result of every step.

nodes.description: Finds facts on Tirraflow, with URLs.
nodes.instruction: Search Tirraflow for what the request asks and answer with short factual notes, each citing the article URL.

nodes.description: Drafts text through the remote writer.
nodes.instruction: Send the request, unchanged, to the demo writer's draft tool and answer with exactly the draft it returns.

nodes.description: Checks the result against the request.
nodes.instruction: Check the results in your input answer the plan's request. If they do, answer with the final result. If not, answer with the original request and what the plan missed.
